entry.name: abl.device.utility~
entry.description: This object can be used to change the gain, separate a single channel from a stereo signal, widen or narrow the stereo image or suppress DC offsets.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: audition_bass_mono
attributes.digest: Audition Bass Mono
attributes.description: Solos the mono bass frequencies. When enabled, only the low frequencies can be heard. This can help to tune.

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: balance
attributes.digest: Balance
attributes.description: Pans the input signal anywhere within the stereo field. [-1., 1.]

attributes.name: bass_mono
attributes.digest: Bass Mono
attributes.description: Converts low frequencies of the input signal to mono. This is useful for avoiding coloration of low frequencies when they are replayed in mono.

attributes.name: bass_mono_frequency
attributes.digest: Bass Mono Frequency
attributes.description: Sets the bass mono threshold frequency (in Hz). Signals below this frequency are converted to mono when the bassmono attribute is on. [50., 500.]

attributes.name: channelmode
attributes.digest: Channel Mode

choices.label: Only pass the left channel of the input
